0.0: Hmm... Let me tell you the #blegend of the giant Pixie#k, passed down for generations in Orbis.\r\nAccording to ancient records, a giant Pixie, the king of all Pixies, came to Orbis along time ago. Our goddess protected us by chasing him off.\r\n
0.1: So king of the Pixies went into hiding. But now he's back. There are traces of his magic in the cloud pieces. \nHis name is #r#o9300039##k. And I'm certain he's played a part in all of this. The Tower of Goddess appearing, the goddess disappearing, those #rPixiemom#k queens that attacked Hella, everything.
0.2: Oh, adventurer overflowing with faith and courage. Can you save Orbis from the danger of the Pixies?

yes.0: Good thinking. The only way to prevent Orbis from falling into danger is to defeat #rPapa Pixie#k. \r\nUnfortunately, he's quite strong. He's in the #rTower of Goddess#k, but if you're going to face him, bring #bseveral like-minded friends#k.

no.0: Oh, my... If things get any worse with the Pixies, all of Orbis might be in trouble!

1.0: The future of Orbis hangs, quite literally, in the balance...

yes.0: Ok, I have to get ready to go out. You can go back now.

mob.0: It says that the giant Papa Pixie has great magical power. You'll have to be very careful!
